records.title: Upgradation of Thanjavur Airport
details: Part (b) & (c); The routes connecting Thanjavur with Chennai and Bangalore have been allotted to Air Taxi for operation during UDAN 4.2 using a 9-seater aircraft. Upon the readiness of the airport, the airline may start the operations from Thanjavur airport.

records.title: NEW RAILWAY LINE FROM THANJAVUR TO PATTUKOTTAI
details: PART (B); IT WAS INTER-ALIA STATED THAT WITH ABOVE CONSTRAINTS EVERY EFFORT IS BEING MADE TO EXECUTE THE PROJECT EXPEDITIOUSLY.
